haalvu.name: Haalvu
haalvu.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

harpak.name: Harpak
harpak.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

hek.name: Hek
hek.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

hema.name: Hema
hema.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

higasa.name: Higasa
higasa.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

hind.name: Hind
hind.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
